methods.displayName: Throw carried bronze darts at sand crabs

start.instruction: Begin a bounded Ranged session with the exact carried dart stack. Reassess ammunition and health rather than assuming a sustainable or safe trip.

freeInventorySlots.description: No empty position is required to begin; drops and later capacity are outside scope.

consumes.description: At least one exact unpoisoned bronze dart currently carried or equipped.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the Dorgeshuun-crossbow tier or selected goal boundary.
Stop when exact carried ammunition is exhausted.

costs.assumptions: Ammunition beyond the observed stack, food, prayer, safe positioning, loot and death safety are unproven.

methods.reason: A broadly accessible early Ranged start with exact current ammunition and no acquisition claim.

requirements.description: At least one exact unpoisoned bronze dart currently carried or equipped.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for a verified bounded start; no ammunition duration or combat throughput.

sources.notes: The UIM guide lists darts as a strong low-level crab weapon when already made and warns against making them solely for training.
Bronze darts require level 1 Ranged and are consumed thrown weapons.
Sand crabs are low-defence training monsters; no indefinite safety claim is imported.
Exact unpoisoned bronze-dart identity uses the pinned public gameval constant.

methods.displayName: Use a Dorgeshuun crossbow at ammonite crabs

start.instruction: Begin with an exact carried Dorgeshuun crossbow and bone-bolt stack. Reassess ammunition and health; fossil handling and sustained combat support are outside scope.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 28 required to equip the Dorgeshuun crossbow.
Verified completion of Bone Voyage for Fossil Island access; no current capability provider supplies this alias.

freeInventorySlots.description: No empty position is required to begin; fossil drops and later capacity are outside scope.

setupItems.description: One exact Dorgeshuun crossbow currently carried or equipped.

consumes.description: At least one exact bone bolt currently carried or equipped for the next attack.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Ranged target.
Stop when exact carried bone bolts are exhausted.

costs.assumptions: Only current weapon and ammunition are proven. Fossil Island access needs a provider; food, prayer, death safety, fossil storage and future ammunition are not assumed.

methods.reason: A convenient low-cost UIM Ranged setup when access, weapon and current bone bolts are all verified.

requirements.description: One exact Dorgeshuun crossbow currently carried or equipped.
At least one exact bone bolt currently carried or equipped.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for a verified weapon-and-ammo start; no long-term bolt supply or combat throughput.

sources.notes: The UIM guide identifies ammonite crabs and Dorgeshuun crossbow with bone bolts as convenient lower-level training.
Level 28, exact weapon behavior and bone-bolt compatibility were reviewed; quest completion is needed to buy it, not to equip an already-carried weapon.
Fossil Island access and low-defence training behavior were reviewed.
Exact Dorgeshuun crossbow and bone-bolt identities use pinned public gameval constants.
